audit.whatIsWrong: The chart tokens are right but rows 0 and 1 are explained backwards: both layers say Yone wins levels 1 and 2, while whys[0] and whys[1] say Chomp 'dominat[es] the level-1 auto-trade' and that his sustain 'out-value[s] your early poke'. whys[3] and whys[5] likewise say Trundle is ahead on rows labelled Skill.
audit.why: The already-audited Trundle side records exactly this chart — Yone at 1, 2 and two-plus items; Skill at 3, 4-5 and first item; Trundle at 6 — so the tokens stay. What has to move is the text under them. Chomp is 300 range: at level 1 he cannot reach you without walking into Mortal Steel, and Frozen Domain does not exist yet.
audit.corrected: Keep the chart and rewrite whys 0, 1, 3 and 5 so each row's sentence agrees with its own token.

audit.whatIsWrong: Subjugate is described only as 'steals your stats' with no numbers and no duration.
audit.why: Subjugate is 120/100/80s — the same cooldown as Fate Sealed, so the level-6 row is literally a question of who spends first. Riot's text: he steals a percent of your Health, Armor and Magic Resistance immediately, and 'over the next 4 seconds the amount stolen is doubled'. Pillar of Ice is 21s at rank 1 and Frozen Domain 18s, which are the two gaps worth counting in the middle levels.
audit.corrected: Write Subjugate's 120s and its 4-second doubling, and Pillar of Ice's 21s as the window the even rows are built on.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trundle's W and E are swapped everywhere on the page — 'Pillar (W)' and 'Frozen Domain (E)' — and Frozen Domain is called a 'slow field'.
audit.why: W is Frozen Domain and E is Pillar of Ice. The swap is not cosmetic: Frozen Domain is a zone that grants HIM attack speed, move speed and increased healing from all sources — it does not slow you, so 'his slow-field' misdescribes the one place you must not fight. The slow, and the impassable terrain, are Pillar of Ice, and that terrain is what stops Mortal Steel's two-stack dash mid-flight. Chomp also carries an auto-attack reset, so his burst opens on an attack wind-up rather than on a visible cast.
audit.corrected: Frozen Domain (W) is his buff zone — refuse to trade on it. Pillar of Ice (E) is the impassable terrain and slow, 21s at rank 1, and it can wall your Q3 dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fate Sealed is called a knock-up in the late text and in spikes[3].text.
audit.why: Riot's R text: 'Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him.' It is a pull. Yone's only knockup is the two-stack Mortal Steel cast. The mirror flagged the same error from the other side.
audit.corrected: Call it the Fate Sealed pull.

edits.before: Trundle's Chomp shreds your AD and heals him, dominating the level-1 auto-trade.
edits.after: Your Q poke and crit beat a 300-range Chomp before he has Frozen Domain up.

edits.before: At level 2 his Frozen Domain plus Chomp sustain still out-value your early poke.
edits.after: At level 2 Q3's knockup out-trades him before his Domain healing scales.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 Trundle's Pillar zoning and Domain healing keep him ahead in extended trades.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 even out — Pillar of Ice is 21 seconds at rank 1, and that gap is your window.

edits.before: At first item his sustain and pillar zoning still edge your early crit spike.
edits.after: At first item it's even: his sustain against your Blade of the Ruined King.

edits.before: Trundle's Chomp (Q) bites off your AD and heals him while he shoves the wave; his Frozen Domain (E) makes his slow-field a no-go zone you cannot dash through freely with Q2 or E.
edits.after: Trundle's Chomp (Q) bites off your AD and heals him; Pillar of Ice (E) is impassable terrain that stops your Q3 dash, and Frozen Domain (W) is where his attack speed and healing spike.

edits.before: Scaling flips hard to you: Yone's multi-target Spirit Cleave (W) and Fate Sealed knock-up win teamfights while Trundle's single-target R contributes far less at 2+ items.
edits.after: Scaling flips hard to you: Yone's multi-target Spirit Cleave (W) and the Fate Sealed pull win teamfights while Trundle's single-target R contributes far less at 2+ items.

edits.before: By two items the matchup tilts to you. Yone's Spirit Cleave (W) hits multiple targets and Fate Sealed's knock-up is teamfight-defining, while Trundle's single-target R and pillar do far less in 5v5s. Group and play for objectives.
edits.after: By two items the matchup tilts to you. Yone's Spirit Cleave (W) hits multiple targets and Fate Sealed's pull is teamfight-defining, while Trundle's single-target R and his pillar do far less in 5v5s. Group and play for objectives.

edits.before: Trundle out-trades you at 1-2: Chomp (Q) shreds your attack damage and heals him, so any auto-war on his terms bleeds you. Farm safely, keep the wave central, and don't walk into Pillar (W) range for a free lock.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours: Chomp (Q) is a 300-range auto reset, so stay outside it and poke with Mortal Steel. Frozen Domain (W) is his buff zone, not a slow — refuse to trade on it and his sustain never gets started.

edits.before: His level-6 Subjugate (R) is the crux — it steals your bonus health and resists just as you commit Fate Sealed, so it can flip your kill attempt into his. Don't E in blind; bait the R or wait out its long cooldown. Skill windows open at 3 and 6 when his key tools are down.
edits.after: His level-6 Subjugate (R) is the crux — it steals a share of your health, armour and MR the moment you commit, then doubles the theft over 4 seconds, flipping your kill attempt into his. Bait it or wait out the 120-second cooldown; your even windows are level 3, 4-5 and first item.

edits.after: Sidestep Pillar of Ice (E) placement — it is impassable terrain your Q3 dash cannot cross

edits.before: Fight away from his Frozen Domain (E) slow field where his AS and MS spike
edits.after: Fight away from Frozen Domain (W), where his attack speed and healing spike

edits.before: Land Pillar (W) to lock you, then Chomp (Q) your AD and sustain through your poke
edits.after: Land Pillar of Ice (E) to wall you off, then Chomp (Q) your AD and sustain

edits.before: Drag every trade onto Frozen Domain (E) for the AS/MS and healing boost
edits.after: Drag every trade onto Frozen Domain (W) for the AS/MS and healing boost

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Trundle's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Subjugate takes a share of your health, armour and MR, then doubles it over 4 seconds. Refuse the 6 all-in — 120s.

edits.before: Steals your stats. Don’t brawl into it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Steals your health and resists, doubling over 4 seconds. 120s at rank 1.

notes: Trundle's W and E are swapped in five separate strings on this page — 'Pillar (W)' and 'Frozen Domain (E)'. W is Frozen Domain, E is Pillar of Ice. The swap carried a real mechanical error with it: the page calls Frozen Domain a 'slow field', when Riot's text gives it no slow at all — it grants Trundle attack speed, move speed and increased healing from all sources. The slow and the impassable terrain both belong to Pillar of Ice, and that terrain is what can stop Mortal Steel's two-stack dash. packet suspectName "Fate Sealed's" is a FALSE POSITIVE on the apostrophe, but the sentence it flagged did contain a real error: Fate Sealed is a pull, not a knock-up. No chart tokens were changed — they already match the mirror; only the four whys that contradicted their own rows were rewritten.
